subject: Restoring muscle's lost signal: how a prostaglandin enzyme unlocks strength in aging
script: From Agewell Brief: Restoring muscle's lost signal: how a prostaglandin enzyme unlocks strength in aging. A new preprint shows that inhibiting 15-PGDH in geriatric mice reawakens a PGE2–IGF1 paracrine circuit, overcoming anabolic resistance and rebuilding muscle strength. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
